name: Cecil
source:
The casino manager of the casino hotel Lurunia.
He's resolute and calm and is acknowledged as superior by those around him he's in a place to become the next owner, but he's really just a kind young man.
His personality in public and private are completely different and nobody knows his true self.
He's allowing the amnesiac protagonist to stay at Lurunia.
